title: ActivityPub: outbound — article to Create{Note} activity
description: On each new article ingested to a federated group: publish Create{Note} activity to group actor's followers. Note content = article body, attributedTo = From header, inReplyTo = In-Reply-To CID activity URL. Include x-usenet-ipfs-cid property with article CID. HTTP Signatures (Mastodon-compatible) on outbound activities. Blocked on: stoa-e70f7626.
